title: setMinPullInterval lacks upper bound, enables owner-induced user DoS
description: Owner can set minPullInterval to a value near type(uint256).max. Once lastPullAt > 0, lastPullAt + minPullInterval overflows in checked arithmetic, reverting every _syncBudget(false) call. All user entrypoints (stake, unstake, claim) brick until owner resets via another setter call. Principal recoverable via emergencyWithdraw (forfeits rewards).
remediation: Cap at a reasonable maximum (e.g., MAX_WINDOW).
